subject: Life Skills
title: Utilities You Forget to Set Up
description: A quick, practical guide to Utilities You Forget to Set Up.

hook.text: A new renter moved in and had no hot water for a week because gas service needed a separate activation.

buildup.text: Electricity, gas, water, internet, and trash are often billed separately by different companies.

discovery.text: Call utility providers two weeks before move-in to schedule activation on your exact start date.

twist.text: Some buildings include certain utilities in rent. Verify which ones to avoid paying twice.

climax.text: Make a checklist: electric, gas, water, internet, renter's insurance. Activate all before you move in.

punchline.text: Set up utilities before the boxes arrive.

quiz.question: When should you contact utility providers before moving?
options: About two weeks before your move-in date
